notes:
Lead source: inbound self-serve sign-up + request for demo. Company background: family-owned regional lifestyle/equipment retailer with growing direct-to-consumer site. Primary pain: product pages show low conversion on complex items (outdoor gear) — customers ask detailed fit/spec questions. Wants instant, high-quality product Q&A and automated attribute extraction to fill missing specs in catalog.

Key quotes / paraphrases: "We get 30–40 messages a day asking the same fit questions — want to automate without sounding robotic." — Alex.

Technical requirements / constraints (as discussed):
- Prefers hosted API for speed of onboarding (self-serve); minimal ops overhead.
- Expected bursty traffic profile: baseline 5–10 qps, holiday peaks ~150–250 qps for 2–4 hour windows. Cost-sensitive — wants per-token controls and fallback to smaller model variant for non-critical responses.
- Latency target: p95 < 300ms for Q&A on product pages; happy with slightly higher for long-form content generation.
- Catalog enrichment: have ~40k SKUs; current data quality inconsistent (missing dimensions, short descriptions). They want an automated pipeline to extract attributes and generate canonical descriptions.
- Model preferences: open to Redwood-curated smaller models or mid-sized LLMs; prefer deterministic templating for attribute outputs.
- Security: SSO (SAML) desired for admin console; audit logs for content updates. Not strictly enterprise — SOC2 would be nice but not mandatory immediately.

POC ask: 2-week POC to validate response quality and ingestion pipeline. Redwood deliverables proposed: hosted test workspace, sample embedding index for 5k SKUs, basic streaming Q&A widget sample, cost/throughput estimate for production.
